data.one_liner: Synchronous key‑value storage with in‑memory cache and automatic disk backup.
data.what_it_does: Provides fast read/write of primitive types, maps and lists by keeping data in memory and persisting each operation to a file. The API is simple: read, write, remove, listen to changes.
use_when: Need simple persistent key/value storage across app launches
Want immediate read access without async calls
avoid_when: Require complex queries, indexing or relational data
Need guaranteed disk write before next operation without awaiting
strengths: Works on all major Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Not a full database – no indexing or relations
Backup to disk runs in background, so write completion isn’t immediate

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard Flutter plugin for simple key/value storage with platform‑specific implementations

alternatives.why_pick_it: Fast NoSQL box storage with optional encryption and richer query features
